config.scope: Paired full-training exploratory sample. Accuracy is an outcome; validation plateau or safety cap ends training. Public FRESNEL snapshot is provisional until account specification, calibration and server validation are verified.

device_profile.compiler: Pulser global analog pulses, explicit layout, SDK QPU validation
device_profile.scope: Comparable driving/interaction/encoding/probing scales adapted within target constraints; not a reproduction or a provider-confirmed operating optimum

target.generation_verification: Provider lists QPU-FRESNEL-100PQ as Orion Beta; account-specific device generation is unverified

calibration.scope: No FRESNEL-specific power/cycle measurements supplied. Public SDK pulse/noise specifications are not electrical measurements. Populate from traceable measurements; missing values must not be replaced with zero.

alves2026.title: Energetics of Rydberg-atom Quantum Computation
alves2026.authors: Óscar Alves, Marco Pezzutto, Yasser Omar
alves2026.boundary: Radiation-source energy; excludes electrical conversion, control electronics, HVAC and host processing
alves2026.platform: Paper's cesium gate-model experimental reference, not Pasqal FRESNEL

carrasco2026.title: Energy efficiency of quantum computers
carrasco2026.boundary: Reference machine/facility electrical power including HVAC and hardware-control computers
carrasco2026.platform: Harvard rubidium-87 n=53 digital neutral-atom reference; not Pasqal calibration

pasqal2023.title: Quantum Computing to Greener Calculations
pasqal2023.boundary: Historical vendor total-power statement; not a research paper or a current FRESNEL measurement
pasqal2023.locator: Neutral atoms, a greener quantum architecture: approximately 2.6 kW

radiation_source.raman_to_microwave_power_mapping: Assumption: charge Raman controls at the paper's derived microwave radiation power; mechanisms differ
radiation_source.blue_global_scaling: Assumption: one local-blue reference power per illuminated atom; shared infrared beam counted once
radiation_source.constant_on_power: Assumption: reference source powers held fixed for pulse-on windows, regardless of simulated Rabi rate. Not a Rabi-power calibration or validated architecture ranking.

schedule_timing.assumption: Our compiled recipes keep a fixed register; no motion/reconfiguration/reloading is charged. Their real overheads need calibration; paper reset/readout times are transferred as a scenario.

transferred_scenarios.tariff_status: Illustrative user-changeable arithmetic assumption, not a market quote or QPU service price

fresnel_beta_nominal_throughput.caveat: Page prose also calls available hardware Orion Gamma. The table specifically labels this entry Beta; confirm generation/device ID for the actual booked QPU.

protocol.readout: Training-only scaling; multi-output OLS/ridge, same alpha grid, minimum mean validation MSE
protocol.validation_rule: Fit on one finite-shot training feature set; average loss over independent validation measurement repetitions
protocol.optimizer: Alternating linear-head refits and sampled minibatch SPSA, frozen head between checkpoints
protocol.selection: Minimum mean validation MSE; ties retain earliest checkpoint; test labels never select models
protocol.completion: Validation-loss plateau or maximum SPSA steps; neither proves global convergence
protocol.cost: All consumed training, repeated validation, objective and discarded-checkpoint work, regardless of selected step
protocol.initialization: Paired initial offsets and common random measurement seeds at step zero; validation repetitions independent
protocol.inference: Selected and terminal models evaluated after selection; same-checkpoint measurements reused and charged once
protocol.prior_test_inspection: Exploratory MNIST sample; earlier studies inspected overlapping official-test subsets
protocol.calibrated_energy: Unknown without traceable target-specific power/cycle/setup and external classical measurements
protocol.noise_trajectories: Monte Carlo emulator approximation, not extra physical shots or independent experimental repeats
